# grafana-docker-compose

> A Grafana Docker Compose monitoring stack: Grafana with a provisioned Prometheus data source and Node Exporter dashboard, Prometheus with alert rules, Alertmanager, Node Exporter and cAdvisor for server and container metrics.

Run it with `cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d`, or `docker stack deploy -c docker-compose.yml monitoring-stack` on Docker Swarm. Grafana is on port 1296, Prometheus on 9090, Alertmanager on 9093.

## Docs

- [Project website](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/): quick start, Node Exporter, cAdvisor, alerting and Docker Swarm guides, configuration reference
- [Node Exporter dashboard](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/node-exporter-dashboard/): screenshot, the eight panels with their PromQL, and how to import the JSON into another Grafana
- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/): monitoring guides built on this stack
- [How Prometheus Alertmanager routes, groups and mutes alerts](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/prometheus-alertmanager-explained): Alertmanager explained with a real config: the routing tree, grouping, receivers, inhibition and silences, and the parts of the file you fill in yourself.
- [Using $labels and $value in Prometheus alert annotations](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/prometheus-alert-rule-templates): How the $labels, $value and $externalLabels placeholders work in Prometheus alerting rules, with printf and humanize examples taken from eight working rules.
- [Silencing an alert in Alertmanager from the UI or amtool](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/alertmanager-silence): Silence an alert in Alertmanager from the web UI on port 9093 or with amtool silence add: matchers, duration, comments, listing and expiring silences early.
- [Grafana-managed alerts or Prometheus rules: which to use](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/grafana-alerts-vs-prometheus-rules): Grafana-managed alert rules compared with Prometheus alert rules and Alertmanager: where each is evaluated, how to alert on the latest value, and which to pick.
- [Alertmanager settings that keep a small server quiet](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/alertmanager-best-practices): Practical Alertmanager best practices for one to five servers: group_by, repeat_interval, a separate critical receiver, Slack templates and alerts that work.
- [Moving Grafana dashboards around as JSON](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/grafana-export-import-dashboard): Export a Grafana dashboard as JSON, import it on another server, duplicate it with Save as copy, and provision it from a file the way this Docker stack does.
- [Which registry to pull the cAdvisor image from](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/cadvisor-image-gcr-vs-docker-hub): Where the cAdvisor container image lives: gcr.io up to v0.55.1, ghcr.io for v0.53.0 and later, and why the google/cadvisor image on Docker Hub stops at 2019.
- [The cAdvisor container metrics worth a Grafana panel](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/cadvisor-metrics): The cAdvisor metrics worth graphing for Docker containers: CPU, working set memory, throttling, network, filesystem and restarts, with PromQL for each one.
- [The PromQL queries you need for one server, on one page](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/promql-cheat-sheet): A PromQL cheat sheet built on a real Node Exporter stack: selectors, matchers, range vectors, rate, aggregation, comparisons and the functions alerts use.
- [Writing if-then logic in PromQL with filters and bool](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/promql-if-function): PromQL has no if function. How comparison filters, the bool modifier, and, or, unless and vector(0) express conditions in queries, panels and alert rules.
- [Counting per second in PromQL: rate, irate and increase](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/promql-rate): How PromQL rate, irate and increase work on counters, how to pick the range, why the docs prefer rate for alerts, and why this stack's alerts use rate.
- [Grouping PromQL results with by and without](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/promql-group-by): Group by in PromQL: sum by, avg by, count by and without, where the clause can go, how labels are dropped, and examples from a Node Exporter stack.
- [Rewriting labels at query time with label_replace](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/promql-label-replace): How PromQL label_replace works: argument order, anchored regex, capture groups, what happens without a match, label_join, and when relabeling is better.
- [Catching broken Prometheus rules before they ship with promtool](https://projects.halit.org/grafana-docker-compose/blog/promtool): How to use promtool from the Prometheus Docker image: check config and rules, unit test an alert with test rules, read a failure, and run it all in CI.
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/grafana-docker-compose/blob/main/Readme.md): features, install commands and service ports
- [docker-compose.yml](https://github.com/halitsever/grafana-docker-compose/blob/main/docker-compose.yml): services, image versions, ports and volumes
- [prometheus.yml](https://github.com/halitsever/grafana-docker-compose/blob/main/prometheus.yml): scrape jobs; add more servers under the `node` job
- [Alert rules](https://github.com/halitsever/grafana-docker-compose/blob/main/prometheus/rules/node.yml): instance down, CPU, memory, disk, network errors and load
- [alertmanager.yml](https://github.com/halitsever/grafana-docker-compose/blob/main/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml): routing and commented email and Slack receivers
- [.env.example](https://github.com/halitsever/grafana-docker-compose/blob/main/.env.example): Grafana admin password, root URL and Prometheus retention
- [Article](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/using-grafana-system-monitoring-deep-dive-docker-halit-sever-iu6kf): walkthrough of using Grafana for system monitoring with Docker
